entries.title: Build a Reusable Card with Props
entries.matchText: Build a Reusable Card with Props Foundations Build one typed component and reuse it with different caller-provided information. a reusable typed component combines one JSX structure with a checked props contract. Create a three-property props interface and a card component that applies it, displays every prop, and is rendered three times with different values.

entries.title: Compose a page from reusable components
entries.matchText: Compose a page from reusable components Foundations Break a page into components with clear visual or behavioral responsibilities and compose them in a parent. component composition builds larger interfaces by nesting and arranging smaller components. Create at least three focused child components and one page component that renders all three in semantic regions. Pass at least one value from the page into a child.

entries.title: Model local UI state
entries.matchText: Model local UI state Foundations Choose the smallest state shape that represents every valid UI situation without duplicating derived facts. local UI state is component-owned information that can change through interaction and affect rendering. Create a component with a boolean open state and a typed selectedId state that permits one string id or null. Derive `hasSelection` from selectedId and render content for both questions.

entries.title: Handle typed user events
entries.matchText: Handle typed user events Foundations Type event handlers according to the actual interaction and element they receive. a typed React event describes the event API and currentTarget element available to the handler. Create a component with a controlled input and form. Use a named typed change handler and a named typed submit handler that prevents default submission.

entries.title: Render idle, loading, success, empty, and error states
entries.matchText: Render idle, loading, success, empty, and error states Foundations Model idle, loading, success, empty, and error states so each produces clear interface feedback. an async UI state model identifies the current operation stage and carries stage-specific data. Create a discriminated union for idle, loading, success with a typed data array, and error with a message. Create a component that renders every status and distinguishes empty from populated success.

entries.title: Application shell and layout wrapper
entries.matchText: Application shell and layout wrapper Navigation & Layout Create one semantic application frame that surrounds changing routed content. an application shell is the persistent header, navigation, and content structure shared by a set of pages. Create a typed AppShell receiving children. Render a header, nav with at least two links, and one main region containing children.

entries.title: Responsive shell with header, sidebar, and main region
entries.matchText: Responsive shell with header, sidebar, and main region Navigation & Layout Use one semantic shell whose CSS adapts from a narrow stack to a wider sidebar layout. a responsive shell rearranges the same meaningful regions according to available space. Create shell JSX with header, aside navigation, and main. Add CSS that uses one column by default and at least two columns above a breakpoint.

Create a component with boolean drawer state, a button using aria-expanded and aria-controls, and a nav with the matching id. Close it when Escape is pressed.

entries.title: Route configuration and navigation links
entries.matchText: Route configuration and navigation links Navigation & Layout Map paths to page components and navigate with links that preserve client routing behavior. a route associates a URL pattern with the interface rendered for that location. Create at least three route objects with distinct paths and elements. Create navigation with three Link components whose to values match those paths.

entries.title: Nested routes and shared layouts
entries.matchText: Nested routes and shared layouts Navigation & Layout Represent shared route structure as a parent layout with an outlet for nested pages. a nested route renders its child inside the matched parent route's outlet. Create a parent route object with an element and at least three child route objects. Create the parent layout component with navigation and Outlet.

entries.matchText: Detail routes with URL parameters Navigation & Layout Use one route and page component for many resources identified by a URL parameter. a route parameter is a named changing segment captured from a matched path. Create a route object with a named id parameter and a detail component that reads that exact parameter, handles its missing case, and displays or uses it.

entries.matchText: Update and Delete Safely Persistence Basics Update and delete single rows using id predicates. targeted mutations by primary key. Write updateTitle(id,title) and deleteItem(id) returning boolean found flags.

entries.title: Wrap Related Writes in a Transaction
entries.matchText: Wrap Related Writes in a Transaction Persistence Basics Wrap related writes in a transaction with commit/rollback. an atomic unit of multiple statements. Write transfer(from,to,amount) using BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK around two updates.

entries.title: Paginate Large Results with Cursors
entries.matchText: Paginate Large Results with Cursors Persistence Basics Paginate with keyset/cursor filters instead of deep OFFSET. a seek method using the last seen key. Write listPage(afterId, limit) using WHERE id > $1 ORDER BY id LIMIT $2.

entries.title: Write Joins That Answer Real Questions
entries.matchText: Write Joins That Answer Real Questions Query & Index Skills Write joins that answer product questions without N queries. a single query linking related tables. Write SQL joining posts to users returning title and email.

entries.title: Read an Execution Plan and Spot a Seq Scan
entries.matchText: Read an Execution Plan and Spot a Seq Scan Query & Index Skills Read execution plans to choose indexes deliberately. planner output describing access paths. Write a function that includes an EXPLAIN ANALYZE prefix for a given sql string.

entries.title: Add an Index for a Hot Filter Path
entries.matchText: Add an Index for a Hot Filter Path Query & Index Skills Add targeted indexes for real filter paths. a structure accelerating lookups. Write SQL for a partial index on status where deleted_at IS NULL.

entries.title: Choose Soft Delete, Hard Delete, or Archive
entries.matchText: Choose Soft Delete, Hard Delete, or Archive Query & Index Skills Choose soft delete when retention/undo matters. a deleted_at marker instead of immediate removal. Write softDelete(id) and listActive() SQL helpers.

entries.title: Hash and Verify Passwords
entries.matchText: Hash and Verify Passwords Auth on the Server Hash at rest and verify with a slow hash compare. a one-way password digest. Write hashPassword and verifyPassword using bcrypt-style API calls.

entries.title: Issue and Verify a JWT
entries.matchText: Issue and Verify a JWT Auth on the Server Issue and verify JWTs as bearer credentials. a signed token carrying subject claims. Write signToken(userId) and verifyToken(token) wrappers.

entries.title: Enforce Authorization in Middleware
entries.matchText: Enforce Authorization in Middleware Auth on the Server Enforce authentication at the service boundary before handlers. a guard that rejects anonymous calls. Write requireAuth(req,res,next) that checks Bearer token and sets req.user.

entries.title: Scope Queries to the Authenticated Tenant
entries.matchText: Scope Queries to the Authenticated Tenant Auth on the Server Scope reads and writes to the authenticated tenant. tenant_id predicates derived from the session. Write listItemsForTenant(tenantId) with WHERE tenant_id=$1.

entries.title: Enqueue Background Jobs from a Handler
entries.matchText: Enqueue Background Jobs from a Handler Async Work & Integration Enqueue background work from a request handler. a job message for workers. Write afterCreate(user) that enqueues an email job payload.

entries.title: Retry Failed Jobs with Backoff
entries.matchText: Retry Failed Jobs with Backoff Async Work & Integration Retry with backoff and isolate poison messages. a retry policy plus DLQ. Configure a job with attempts and backoff settings in code.

entries.title: Call a Third-Party API with Timeout
entries.matchText: Call a Third-Party API with Timeout Async Work & Integration Call third parties with explicit timeouts. an abortable outbound request. Write fetchUser(id) that aborts after 3000ms.

entries.title: Verify an Incoming Webhook Signature
entries.matchText: Verify an Incoming Webhook Signature Async Work & Integration Verify webhook signatures before side effects. HMAC/signature check on raw body. Write verify(signature, rawBody, secret) returning boolean using crypto timing-safe compare.

entries.title: Emit Structured Logs with Request Context
entries.matchText: Emit Structured Logs with Request Context Reliability & Ops Basics Emit structured logs with request context. JSON-like log events with fields. Write logInfo(ctx, message) that includes requestId from ctx.

entries.title: Expose Liveness and Readiness Checks
entries.matchText: Expose Liveness and Readiness Checks Reliability & Ops Basics Expose health/readiness endpoints for operators and load balancers. a cheap dependency check endpoint. Write health handler that checks db with select 1 and returns 200/503.

entries.title: Cache Hot Reads and Invalidate on Write
entries.matchText: Cache Hot Reads and Invalidate on Write Reliability & Ops Basics Cache hot reads and invalidate on write. explicit get/set/del around a key. Write getItemCached(id) and updateItem(id,title) that deletes the cache key.

entries.title: Write a Backward-Compatible Migration
entries.matchText: Write a Backward-Compatible Migration Reliability & Ops Basics Sequence backward-compatible migrations across deploys. expand then contract phases. Write two migration strings: add nullable nickname, then later set NOT NULL after backfill comment.

entries.title: Containerize a Service with a Multi-Stage Build
entries.matchText: Containerize a Service with a Multi-Stage Build Reliability & Ops Basics Containerize with a multi-stage Dockerfile. a build stage plus a slim runtime stage. Write a Dockerfile snippet with FROM build and FROM runtime copying dist.

entries.title: Separate Controllers from Use-Case Logic
entries.matchText: Separate Controllers from Use-Case Logic Architecture Habits Separate controllers from use-case logic. a function taking plain inputs returning plain results. Write createItemUseCase(input, repo) and a handler that calls it.

entries.title: Keep Domain Rules Free of HTTP and SQL Details
entries.matchText: Keep Domain Rules Free of HTTP and SQL Details Architecture Habits Keep domain rules free of HTTP and SQL details. pure functions/entities over DTOs at the center. Write pure function canPlaceOrder(cart) returning boolean based on item count and total.

entries.title: Prevent N+1 Queries with Batching
entries.matchText: Prevent N+1 Queries with Batching Architecture Habits Batch related loads instead of querying per row. one IN/ANY query for related ids. Write loadUsersByIds(ids) using WHERE id = ANY($1).

entries.title: Record an Architecture Decision Briefly
entries.matchText: Record an Architecture Decision Briefly Architecture Habits Record significant architecture decisions briefly beside the code. a lightweight decision record. Write a template string adr(title) containing Context, Options, Decision, Consequences headings.
